assertions.name: assert.http-4xx
assertions.detail: Probe will assert HTTP response status is in [400, 409].

assertions.name: assert.error-references-immutability
assertions.detail: Probe will assert error body contains one of: "immutable", "ManagedSystem", "cannot be changed".

assertions.name: assert.vmsize-unchanged
assertions.detail: Probe will GET pool after rejection and assert vmSize equals original.
